programme.title: UFO Hunters: Underwater Alien Bases
programme.desc: On November 11th, 1987, the small town of Gulf Breeze, Florida is inundated with UFO sightings. More than 200 witnesses see strange, unexplained lights in the sky.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Nazi UFOs
programme.desc: It has long been suspected that Nazi leaders had more than a passing interesting in the occult and UFOs.

programme.title: Area 51, Roswell Crash, Alien Abductions
programme.desc: Area 51 er centrumfor UFO-forskning og udenjordiske væsener. Her udforsker vi Roswell, hvor den berygtede UFO styrtede ned i 1947, og så ser vi på Allagash-bortførelsen. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Belgian UFO
programme.desc: I denne programserie ser vi på uløste mysterier. Denne episode inkluderer: Belgian UFO, (Pts. 1 & 2), UD: I.D. Swap, Brenda's Fire and Philip Breen & UD. Dette program vises uden undertekster

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Kecksburg UFO
programme.desc: I denne programserie ser vi på uløste mysterier. Denne episode inkluderer: Kecksburg UFO (Pts. 1 & 2), Update: Pizza Man & 3rd Anniversary Reunion, Unknown Arsonist & UD and Hospital Babynap. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Alien Harvest
programme.desc: It's a disturbing pattern that's been going on for the past 40 years--thousands of cows seemingly slaughtered in the same strange, meticulous way on ranches around the world.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: UFO Relics
programme.desc: From microscopic particles to large pieces of unknown metal--UFO "trace cases" offer some of the most convincing evidence that UFOs may have been visiting earth for centuries.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Underwater Area 51
programme.desc: Everyone's heard of Area 51--Groom Lake, Nevada. However, 2,500 miles away there's an underwater facility that's also highly secretive.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: Texas UFO
programme.desc: I denne programserie ser vi på uløste mysterier. Denne episode inkluderer: Scared to Death, Texas UFO, Butch Cassidy and Sibling Search & Update. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: Unsolved Mysteries: UFO Odyssey
programme.desc: I denne programserie ser vi på uløste mysterier. Denne episode inkluderer: UFO Odyssey, Reporter's Trucker and Haunted Mansion. Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters II: Tales from the Universe
programme.desc: Italienske ufologer udforsker beviser på rumvæsner i historie og folklore. Er vi blevet overvåget siden oldtiden? Dette program vises uden undertekster.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: UFO Surveillance
programme.desc: Ever since Roswell, observers have noted that UFOs allegedly appear in locations that are already full of secrets and mystery: namely, weapons labs. The question is, why?

programme.title: UFO Hunters: The Silencers
programme.desc: UFOs are the biggest mystery of our time and somebody--or something--seems determined to keep it that way.

programme.title: UFO Hunters: Area 52
programme.desc: Area 51 is considered the ultimate top-secret facility, one that UFO investigators believe houses an extraterrestrial secret. But is there an even more secretive facility?

programme.title: UFO Hunters: First Response
programme.desc: For decades, it has been believed that the United States military has had unexplained encounters with the UFO phenomena.

programme.title: Pas på, politiet kommer
programme.desc: Slagsbrødrene Wilbur Walsh (Bud Spencer) og Matt Kirby (Terence Hill) slår pjalterne sammen og planlægger at røve et supermarked, men planen går så skævt, at de to småforbrydere i stedet ender med at melde sig ind i politikorpset!

programme.title: Buddy gi'r en håndfuld øretæver
programme.desc: Trinity-seriestjernen Bud Spencer vender tilbage til det vilde vesten i komedien om fupmageren, Buddy, der forveksles med en læge, efter at hans ven, Cocoa utilsigtet stjæler en kuffert med kirurgiske instrumenter.

programme.title: De kalder mig Trinity - Djævlens højre hånd
programme.desc: Den seje dusørjæger Trinity (Terence Hill) beslutter at besøge sin halvbror Bambino (Bud Spencer), der ernærer sig som hestetyv og plattenslager.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Trinity
programme.desc: Verdens populæreste spaghettihelte, Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er denne gang meget mod deres vilje kommet til at optræde som tapre mænd.

programme.title: Cement i armen
programme.desc: Rulleskøjteløberen Rosco får et lift med lastbilchaufføren Mason, men de bliver stoppet af færdselspolitiet, som tror at de er to bankrøvere.

programme.title: Lige eller ulige
programme.desc: Halvbrødrene Johnny (Terence Hill) og Charlie (Bud Spencer) sendes på en hemmelig mission for at afsløre bagmændende bag gangstervældet, der har bredt sig i Floridas sports og spille miljø.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: Som altid er de to brødre konstant på kant, men en ting kan få dem til at finde sammen igen. Hvis der er andre, der skal have nogle øretæver og det sker tit. Denne gang er de taget til Afrika, hvor de lever af at tage skydegale turister på safari.

programme.title: Tyve & røvere
programme.desc: 280 Punds øretæver bliver sluppet løs på Miamis intetanende mafia! "Tyve & røvere" foregår i Miami og handler om den hårdtprøvede betjent Parker (Bud Spencer), der bliver sendt ud for at fange den lille og uinteressante tyveknægt Roma (Tomas Milian).

programme.title: Som sendt fra himlen
programme.desc: Laura skal giftes med Thorsten. I kirken svarer Laura nej, hvorefter hun stikker af. Hun ankommer til Alfred Kraghs hjem. Hun tror at Alfred er psykolog og senere smugler.

programme.title: Hør, Var Der Ikke En, Som Lo?
programme.desc: Portræt af en ung arbejdsløs mand (Bodil vindende Jesper Christensen), der i slutningen af trediverne driver rundt i Københavns gader. Han går til kontrol, han træffer politisk aktive arbejdere, får tid til at gå på biblioteket, og han finder også en pige

programme.title: Vores lille by
programme.desc: Vores lille by er en ganske almindelig samling af huse et tilfældigt sted i Danmark beboet af ganske almindelige mennesker. Ingenting af betydning er sket indenfor de sidste 100 år eller deromkring.

programme.title: Gøngehøvdingen
programme.desc: Svenskerne har besat store dele af Danmark. Svend Poulsen kæmper sammen med andre gønger for at hjælpe den danske konge. Da kongen mangler penge, får Svend til opgave at transporterer 50.000 rigsdaler gennem fjendens linjer.

programme.title: Krudt og klunker
programme.desc: København 1890erne. Dette er historien om, hvorledes Therese Schrøder kom på pension hos professor Jacobsen og blev børnenes barnepige, hvad der havde til følge, at hun traf sin sømand. Dette skabte røre i de borgerlige cirkler dengang.

programme.title: OVIRI
programme.desc: Da maleren Paul Gauguin i 1893 vender tilbage til Paris efter sit første Tahiti-ophold med 66 malerier og 4 francs i lommen, er han overbevist om, at hans karriere vil tage fart – men det sker ikke.

programme.title: Sønnen Fra Vingården
programme.desc: Konsulen planlægger - sammen med den korrupte borgmester - hvordan han på den snedigste (men også ulovlige) måde kan selv tjene rigtigt mange penge.

programme.title: Nyt legetøj
programme.desc: En kvinde bliver trukket ind i en alvorlig kriminalitet, da hun møder en gammel elsker, en bilmekaniker, der er bekymret for en iværksætter, der har til hensigt at lukke den butik, hvor han arbejder.

programme.title: IFISH: Black Bream - Bemm River, VIC
programme.desc: Traditionally bream fishing is a game of bait and wait... well not if Franks around! Local East Gippsland guru, Frank Milito, gives PW a lesson in using vibes for BIG Bemm River bream, that you really must see!

programme.title: IFISH: Sailfish - Darwin, NT
programme.desc: When Paul hears the word "Darwin", two things come to mind - Barra and Crocs! So when PW got invited to fish for sailfish, in 20m of water, he couldn't say no! Get out your note pad and pen, because you're about to learn how you can do it all yourself!

programme.title: IFISH: Barramundi, Horizontal Falls, WA
programme.desc: There is only one thing better than waking up in the remote pristine wilderness of the Kimberley - and that's fishing it! Join the Worsteling tribe as they navigate their way through dense mangrove systems in search of the mighty BARRAMUNDI!

programme.title: IFISH: Yellowtail Kingfish, Jervis Bay, NSW
programme.desc: "Catch the fresh bait, get the BIG fish!" Join the team for a step by step lesson in down rigging fresh baits for big angry Kings!

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 1
programme.desc: Robson Green, the actor and host of Extreme Fishing TV series is our guest. He has never fished for Icelandic salmon. We travel to the remote pools of Kjarrá by helicopter and fish pools that are untouched the whole summer.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 2
programme.desc: Charles and Alex Jardine travel to the highlands of Iceland looking for monster arctic char. Charles Jardine is a respected artist who specializes in painting fish and fisherman. The river they fish is a gin clear river, home to some huge trout.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 3
programme.desc: Tiggy Pettifer, a passionate angler, is visiting Iceland. She is a well known personality in the UK being a former employee of the royal family. Tiggy gos to lake Thingvallavatn and looks for the Ice age brown trout that the lake is famous for.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 4
programme.desc: The 93 year old Lilla Rowcliffe is coming to Iceland for the 30th time. Fishing the same river. Big Laxá. She brings along her grandson and great grandson that is 11 years old. Lilla has had an astonishing live and shares a bit of that live with us.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 5
programme.desc: Mother and daughter fish both river Vídidalsá and river Midfjardará. The mother Joanna Gibson is taken along with her daughter Marina Gibson who is a highly skilled fisherman and runs her own very successful fly fishing school in Europe.

programme.title: Icelandic Tails: Episode 6
programme.desc: Robson Green is back with a friend and a colleague. Actor James Murray joins him for an adventure in Iceland. Fishing Laxá in Asum, or just Asum the two give a great performance in this famous river. Competition is on.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Lake Otamangakau
programme.desc: Andrew Harding and Matt Hince team up to visit a huge man-made lake - one of New Zealand's most famous trophy trout waters - in the country's North Island: Lake Otamangakau.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Southland Smelters
programme.desc: New Zealand's Southland's four major rivers are famous as brown trout fisheries, especially in the upper and middle sections, but in this episode Anto Hall and Mike Wilkinson are heading to the estuaries, to fish the annual smelt run.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Golden Bay Kingfish
programme.desc: Discovering new waters to fish is among the pinnacles of the fly fishing experience, and this saltwater flats fishery, Golden Bay, is just such a gem. Kingfish have a unique relationship with short-tailed stingrays, which they use as mobile cover.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Backcountry Kaimanawas
programme.desc: This episode of Pure Fly NZ sees a helicopter ride take anglers Cory Scott and Chris Charland deep into the the mountains to target New Zealand's famous trophy trout, but will an approaching weather-bomb cause them a headache.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Tauranga Taupo
programme.desc: Lake Taupo was formed in the caldera caused by an enormous volcanic explosion. The Tauranga is one of the few tributaries that the lake's legendary rainbow trout use to spawn.

programme.title: Pure Fly NZ: Autumn Chromers
programme.desc: The South Island's Otago Lakes District is the location for remarkable autumn trout fishing brought about by the fish leaving the lakes and heading upstream to spawn.

programme.desc: Robson Green travels the World challenging the best fisherman to catch the biggest, best fish across the planet.

programme.desc: Can't decide whether you're a barra or blue water kinda person? Well, put your worries behind you, because this week, we've got it all!

programme.title: IFISH: Mako Shark, St Helens, TAS
programme.desc: One has a shell and the other big teeth. One swims the open oceans while the other crawls beneath. One makes me lick my lips while the other has me scared. I'd only get in the water with one - even if I was dared!

programme.title: IFISH: Ballarat, VIC & Nomatu Is. FIJI
programme.desc: From VIC to Fiji in just 30 minutes.

programme.title: IFISH: Hawkesbury River, NSW
programme.desc: "There's an old saying that every pound of jewfish you catch, you need to spend at least one hour fishing for them." This is true in most cases... unless you're fishing with Wayne "Mulloway" Annetts!

programme.title: IFISH: ATA Lodge, Alagnak River, Alaska - Part 1
programme.sub-title: ATA Lodge, Alagnak River, Alaska - Part 1
programme.desc: Have you ever dreamed of fishing somewhere so fish rich, that the thousands of fish create one big black mass? Well. come along to ATA Lodge in the remote Alaskan wilderness and get ready for... The Black Hole!

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby
programme.desc: En forældreløs piges (Mel Harris) søgen efter sin fortid begynder med et barndomsfoto af hende selv ved siden af en sjælden spilledåse og fører hende til en forførende skattejæger. Bemærk: Film vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: At the Midnight Hour
programme.desc: Liz, en smuk barnepige, giver nyt liv til Richard Keaton, en enkemand og videnskabsmand, og hans begavede, men fremmedgjorte søn Andy. Liz' liv er i fare, da hun kommer for tæt på sandheden. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: Da en dusørjæger, der er på sporet af en af hendes lejere, overbeviser Sara McAllister om at slå sig sammen med ham, begynder de et eventyr i den farlige verden af international spionage og kærlighed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: This Matter of Marriage
programme.desc: Arkitekterne Hallie og Donnalee arbejder på et stort byggeprojekt for en excentrisk milliardær, Adam Barr. Hallie, der har ledt efter sin drømmeprins, finder ham pludselig lige ved siden af. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Hard to Forget
programme.desc: Privatdetektiv Max er overbevist om, at Sandra død ikke var et uheld, men at hendes mand John myrdede hende. Da han møder Sandras tvillingesøster Nicky, får han hende til at hjælpe sig med en plan. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: Diamond Girl
programme.desc: Playboy-advokaten Denny kaster aldrig et blik på sin kedelige, men loyale assistent Claire . Men da han opdager, at hun er en usleben diamant, beslutter han sig for at forvandle hende til en skønhed. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: Harlequin: The Waiting Game
programme.desc: Sarah og Amy, der har været bedste venner siden college, arrangerer deres første kunstudstilling i en lille by i New England. Da mystiske fremmede træder ind i deres forsigtige liv og udfolder sig et mysterium.Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster

programme.title: Harlequin: Loving Evangeline
programme.desc: Da Robert får at vide, at hans bror er omkommet i en bådulykke, tager han af sted for at hente liget og møder Evie Shaw. Han bliver besat af sin brors mistænkelige død... og af Evie. Bemærk: Serien vises uden danske undertekster.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Ring-A-Ding Girl
programme.desc: Bunny receives a ring from her fan club in her home town. In the ring she sees the faces of people from her hometown telling her she's needed there so she returns home.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: You Drive
programme.desc: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Long Morrow
programme.desc: Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Self-Improvement of Salvadore Ross
programme.desc: A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
programme.sub-title: Number Twelve Looks Just Like You
programme.desc: In a future where everyone must undergo an operation at the age of 19 to make them identical to everyone else, one woman desperately tries to hang onto her own identity.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Black Leather Jackets
programme.desc: Three tough-looking men on motorcycles disrupt a peaceful suburb when they move in. Yet the neighbors could never imagine just how dangerous these men really are.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Night Call
programme.desc: Mysterious phone calls haunt a disabled woman.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: From Agnes - With Love
programme.desc: A computer technician must deal with the queen of all femme fatales: a computer named Agnes who wreaks havoc on his love life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Spur of the Moment
programme.desc: After being chased on horseback by a terrifying, unidentified figure in black, Anne Henderson faces the biggest decision of her life.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programme.sub-title: An Occurrence at Owl Creek Bridge
programme.desc: A Confederate spy is spared death when the rope meant to hang him miraculously breaks. Or does it?

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Queen of the Nile
programme.desc: Columnist Jordan Herrick is startled to learn that a famous movie actress hasn't aged in years. Intrigued, he investigates... and soon learns a terrifying secret.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: What's in the Box
programme.desc: A cheating husband sees his secret revealed and its horrible consequences on his just-repaired TV set.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Masks
programme.desc: A dying man demands his family wear masks that he's given them at a Mardi Gras party.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programme.sub-title: I Am the Night - Color Me Black
programme.desc: On the day an unpopular idealist is to be executed for the killing of a racist bully, the townsfolk are shocked to see the skies have turned pitch black.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences
programme.desc: A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Caesar and Me
programme.desc: A ventriloquist's dummy goads him into committing burglaries.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Jeopardy Room
programme.desc: Major Ivan Kuchenko is trapped inside a hotel room with Commissar Vassiloff, a hitman, and Boris, his assistant, in the room across the street. Vassiloff has planted a bomb in the room and Ivan must find it within three hours or be blown to bits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Encounter
programme.desc: A World War II veteran and a Japanese-American gardener battle each other over a war that ended more than 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Garrity and the Graves
programme.desc: Jared Garrity arrives in the Old West town of Happiness, Arizona, proclaiming he can revive the dead.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Brain Center at Whipple's
programme.desc: A factory CEO replaces human workers with machines.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Come Wander with Me
programme.desc: A singer's song becomes tragically real.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Where is Everybody?
programme.desc: Mike Ferris finds himself in a town strangely devoid of people. But despite the emptiness, he has the odd feeling that he's being watched...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: One for the Angels
programme.desc: A street salesman cleverly eludes Death. But if he lives, a little girl must die in his place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Mr. Denton on Doomsday
programme.desc: A has-been, drunk gunslinger finds his fast-draw abilities magically restored.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Sixteen-Millimeter Shrine
programme.desc: An aging, former movie star lives and dreams in the past, constantly watching her old movies alone in her room.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Walking Distance
programme.desc: Martin Sloan, driving through the country, leaves his car and starts to walk toward his hometown, Homewood. He finds things exactly as they were when he was a child. He soon realizes he's gone back in time.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Escape Clause
programme.desc: A hypochondriac exchanges his soul for immortality and indestructibility.

programme.title: The Faculty
programme.desc: En gruppe af en lille bys gymnasieelever opdager, at deres lærere er kontrolleret af tankekontrollerende rumvæsner. Fra et smart manuskript af Kevin Williamson (SCREAM) og instrueret af action-eksperten Robert Rodriguez (FROM DUSK TO DAWN).

programme.title: Flame Of Barbary Coast
programme.desc: A cowboy competes with a gambling tycoon on the Barbary Coast for the hand of a beautiful dance-hall queen.

programme.title: In Old California
programme.desc: The Duke plays a young, ambitious pharmacist who moves into a brawling frontier town but locks horns with a local crime lord, bent on keeping the town for himself.

programme.title: Sands Of Iwo Jima (B/W)
programme.desc: Den hårde marinesergent John Stryker er meget upopulær blandt mændene i sin deling, især de nye rekrutter, på grund af den brutale træning, han udsætter dem for.

programme.title: Flying Tigers
programme.desc: John Wayne adds luster to this early WWII film about the famous P-40 Flying Group who soared into battle against the Japanese in defense of China's freedom, Great dogfight scenes!

programme.title: The Lonely Trail
programme.desc: After serving with the Union army, John Wayne returns home to be recruited by the governor of Texas to rid the state of crooked carpetbaggers.

programme.title: Island In The Sky
programme.desc: Filmen foregår efter anden verdenskrig, og John Wayne spiller Dooley, en tidligere militærpilot, der flyver fragtfly og bliver tvunget til at foretage en nødlanding på en frossen sø, fordi han løber tør for brændstof, og flyet kommer ud af kurs.

programme.title: Three Faces West
programme.desc: A Viennese physician and his daughter, refugees from Hitler, become part of a group of North Dakota townspeople planning to relocate from the dust bowl to greener Oregon.

programme.title: Cement i armen
programme.desc: Rulleskøjteløberen Rosco får et lift med lastbilchaufføren Mason, men de bliver stoppet af færdselspolitiet, som tror at de er to bankrøvere.

programme.title: Jeg hedder stadig Trinity
programme.desc: Verdens populæreste spaghettihelte, Terence Hill og Bud Spencer er denne gang meget mod deres vilje kommet til at optræde som tapre mænd.

programme.title: Grizzly Man
programme.desc: Werner Herzog viser "Grizzlymanden" Timothy Treadwells liv og hans 13 somre i en nationalpark i Alaska, hvor han forsøger at beskytte grizzlybjørne. Filmen er fuld af unikke billeder og et glimt ind i sjælen på en mand, der ofrede sig for naturen.

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go
programme.desc: On his last day in the Navy, frogman Elvis discovers a sunken treasure ship. On his first day as a civilian, Elvis starts his new job—self-employed treasure hunter!

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Wings of Desire aka Der Himmel über Berlin
programme.desc: Himlen over Wenders krigshærgede Berlin er fyldt med engle i trench-coats, der usynligt bevæger sig rundt blandt menneskene og lytter til deres fortvivlede tanker og prøver at støtte dem.

programme.title: Det Handler Om Henry
programme.desc: Henry er en succesrig advokat, der altid vil vinde, også selvom det går ud over familien. Et enkelt skud sætter dog en stopper for Henrys karriere og efterlader ham ude af stand til at tage vare på sig selv og uden erindring om livet, han levede før.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: En flytning er for de fleste familier en ny begyndelse. Men for familien Creeds kunne det være begyndelsen til enden. For de er netop flyttet ind ved siden af et sted bygget af børn med knuste drømme, dyrekirkegården.

programme.title: Big Time Presents: Motorcycle Builds
programme.sub-title: How to Buy Your First Motorcycle - BIGTIME
programme.desc: A step-by-step guide to buying a first motorcycle, covering sourcing, pricing, and key checks.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks dives into prototype hell to give Nick a superfast 1969 Chevrolet Chevelle with an LT4 engine. Barlen wants his mother’s 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air to run like a dream for her birthday. Unfortunately, her birthday is in 30 days.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Mike wants Dan to make his prized Mach 1 even more of a muscle car. Richard brings FantomWorks the first ‘his and hers’ restoration – a Sunbeam Tiger and a Fiat Spider – but as Dan soon discovers; the challenges of the two cars are not equal.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: When the 1941 Buick Coupe rolls into FantomWorks, it is the worst possible combination: a very difficult car and very demanding owner. Janelle wants her KZ-750 transformed into a cool stripped down ‘café’ bike – a challenge for FantomWorks new bike shop.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: 72 Charger SE Resurrected
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: The black 1978 Trans Am has a brand new motor and its ready to be fired up for the first time. The Malicious Intent, a 1969 Mustang is ready for the paint shop. The 1972 Corvette. Ugly to beautiful restoration is in the stripping process.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Sean asks Dan to find a 1969 Camaro that can be built into the custom restomod of his dreams. Jeff wants to give his 1969 Cutlass a rare Hurst makeover, but the engine has never run and there are more parts in boxes than on the car.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Emmett believes his 1964 Barracuda is all original. But Dan finds out that the car has hidden damage and a past that nobody expected. Velvet wants Dan to get her 1953 Studebaker Commander running as a surprise for her husband, Travis.

programme.title: Asfalten Kalder
programme.desc: Værterne dykker ned i motorcykeludstyr, sikkerhed og det vigtigste gear til livet på to hjul.

programme.title: Big Time Presents: Mustang Build
programme.desc: The Mustang fights back! Unexpected breakdowns push the team to their limits in this brutal build session.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Nick bought his wife Danielle a 1953 Chevy Pickup for her 28th birthday. The couple wants a perfect FantomWorks restoration. The truck has other ideas. Eric’s rare 1939 LaSalle is a sight to behold, but it hasn’t seen a wrench in eighty years.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: FantomWorks dull the fangs on a 1965 Shelby Cobra kit car and bring a 1964 Dodge Dart back on target.

programme.title: Big Time Presents: Mustang Build
programme.sub-title: Installing $3000 in Mods on our $3000 Mustang
programme.desc: We drop $3K in mods on our $3K Mustang — will the upgrades finally make it worth the build?

programme.title: Big Time Presents: Motorcycle Builds
programme.sub-title: Are $2000 Suspension Upgrades on a Motorcycle Worth it?
programme.desc: Suspension upgrades are installed and tested to measure real-world handling gains.

programme.title: Big Time Presents: Motorcycle Builds
programme.desc: Motorcycle engine types are explained, covering configurations and how they operate.

programme.title: Jet Truck
programme.sub-title: You Play With Fire, You Might Get Burned
programme.desc: Tensions mount in Cayuga as a frightening crash occurs on the drag strip moments before Chris is set to perform his incredibly dangerous first night race of the season.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are working in the paint booth on the Malicious Intent. The 1966 Mustang is sanding out the car to get it ready for the paint booth. The 86 Camaro is being converted into a sniper system under the hood.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: The owner of a C10 pick-up wants a full frame off restoration and as Dan predicted, things get ugly when they peel off the paint. A Heinkel came in with mismatched scooter parts hiding an incredibly rare car - which makes parts almost impossible to find.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Dude, Where's Allysa's Car?
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Larry wants to drive his1959 Cadillac DeVille, but the car has spent decades baking in the Arizona sun. Brian spent years gathering parts to restore his grandfather’s 1960 Bel Air only to find that he’s missing more critical components than he’s found…

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Cap'ing-off the Challenger
programme.desc: A new season of Graveyard Carz, the show wherein abandoned and left­for­death classic Mopars are given a new lease on life.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Manchurian Candidates
programme.desc: Several prominent researchers in the field provide a short history of Mind Control experimentation beginning with the Nazis through to the CIA's infamous MK Ultra program.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Pest House and Sleepwalkers
programme.desc: An earthquake triggers terrifying activity in a house with a dark past. A young woman sees visions in her sleep that lead her to an abandoned hospital.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Whispering and Ethel
programme.desc: After returning home for her mother's funeral, a young woman is terrorized by visions from her past. A musician finds a suicide note that reveals the dark history of his new house.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
programme.sub-title: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
programme.desc: A five-year-old boy claims that his imaginary friend pushed his sister through a second story window. A newly divorced woman relives the terrifying history of the remote cabin she's rented.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Creepy Murder in Room 1046
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane examine the bizarre encounters and baffling twists of the death of Roland T. Owen in Room 1046.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Strange Drowning of Natalie Wood
programme.sub-title: The Strange Drowning of Natalie Wood
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane dive into the eerie circumstances involved in the mystery Natalie Wood's tragic drowning.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Mysterious Poisoned Pill Murders / The Disturbing Murders at Keddie Cabin
programme.sub-title: The Mysterious Poisoned Pill Murders / The Disturbing Murders at Keddie Cabin
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane discuss the bizarre case of the Tylenol murders and the truth behind the Keddie Cabin murders.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Suspicious Assassination of JFK
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane explore the theories, evidence and conspiracies around the controversial JFK assassination.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Grisly Murders of Jack the Ripper
programme.sub-title: The Grisly Murders of Jack the Ripper
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane take a look at the clues to the identity of one of history's most infamous serial killers.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Thrilling Gardner Museum Heist / The Ghastly Cleveland Torso Murders
programme.sub-title: The Thrilling Gardner Museum Heist / The Ghastly Cleveland Torso Murders
programme.desc: Ryan and Shane examine America's biggest property crime and explore the case of the Cleveland Torso Murderer.

programme.title: Buzzfeed Unsolved: The Enigmatic Death of the Isdal Woman
programme.sub-title: The Enigmatic Death of the Isdal Woman
programme.desc: Join Ryan and Shane as they unravel the untold secrets involved in the disturbing murder of the Isdal Woman.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: It Watches Me While I Sleep
programme.sub-title: It Watches Me While I Sleep
programme.desc: The suburban house of two young cousins is filled with scary encounters after a demonic ceramic giraffe is brought into their home.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: The Axe Murderer
programme.desc: An unknown axe murderer still stalks a family he brutally murdered a century ago and then next-door a spirit with a deadly secret haunts a young couple. An off the beaten path bar is stocked with other worldly spirits.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: An Entity in Bed
programme.desc: An entity jumps into a woman's bed and lies down beside her; two sisters' ghosts roam a Civil War-era house; a castle built on an old Indian burial ground is haunted by its original owner; and more.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Jay Thomas
programme.desc: Jay Thomas (Cheers / Murphy Brown) visits his former home in Santa Barbara, California.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Tito Ortiz
programme.desc: Tito Ortiz, (MMA Champion) returns to the Hollywood Hills home where a ghost drove him and his girlfriend Jenna Jameson away many years ago.

programme.title: The Haunting of...: Kristen Renton
programme.desc: Kristen Renton (Sons of Anarchy / Days of Our Lives) went on a ghost hunt aboard the Queen Mary, a docked ship in Long Beach, CA.

programme.title: Wonder Wheel
programme.desc: ”Wonder Wheel” er historien om fire menneskers liv, der flettes sammen i en charmerende og travl forlystelsespark på Coney Island.

programme.title: A Good Old Fashioned Orgy
programme.desc: 30-årige Eric og en gruppe gamle high school-venner holder hver sommer vilde fester i hans forældres strandhus. Da hans far planlægger at sælge huset, må Eric indse, at det er tid til at blive voksen. Der skal dog lige afholdes én sidste fest.

programme.title: Mit hjem i Hampstead
programme.desc: 'Mit hjem i Hampstead' er en sjov og livsbekræftende feelgood-film om, at kærligheden findes de mest uventede steder og beviser én gang for alle, at alder ikke er en hindring for at starte helt forfra.

programme.title: Down To You
programme.desc: Fra det øjeblik de mødes i universitetets kaos i New York City, begynder Al (Freddie Prinze Jr.) og Imogen (Julia Stiles) deres romantiske rejse, hvor ægte kærlighed ofte konkurrer med fristelsen til at vige fra engagementet.

programme.title: Results
programme.desc: To personlige trænere (Cobie Smulders og Guy Pearce) får til opgave at få en nyrig og højst umotiveret kunde (Kevin Corrigan) i form i denne kvikke og sjove komedie om kærlighed og fitness.

programme.title: The Deal
programme.desc: Det ulige par Charlie og Deidre bedrager alt og alle, ikke mindst hele Hollywood-maskinen, hvor de forsøger at få finansieret en ny film. Charlie ændrer manuskriptet fra en intellektuel sovepille til en farvespækket actionfilm..

programme.title: My Bloody Valentine
programme.desc: For 20 år siden krævede en tragisk ulykke på Valentins dag fem minearbejderes liv, da de forlod deres post for at gå til fest. På katastrofens første årsdag vender den eneste overlevende tilbage til byen for at få en blodig hævn.

programme.title: My Week with Marilyn
programme.desc: Marilyn Monroe er det forrige århundredes absolut største kvindelige ikon og er omgivet af en nærmest mytisk aura. Nu vækkes hun til live i 'My Week With Marilyn', der er baseret på virkelige hændelser.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: Operation Galia
programme.desc: Monty’s journey sees him follow the path 33 SAS soldiers took after they were parachuted behind enemy lines to attack the enemy and create chaos to draw Nazi-fascist forces away from the front line.

programme.title: Secret War: Agent Garbo
programme.desc: Juan Pujol, MI6's WWII agent "Garbo," created a fictitious spy network in Lisbon, deceiving the Germans with crucial disinformation and influencing their strategies. After the war, MI6 protected him, and he lived in Venezuela until his death in 1988.

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The IRA Conspiracy
programme.desc: During WWII, the IRA's "S Plan" aimed to bomb Britain, drawing German support to weaken the British. "Operation Green" and "Plan Kathleen" envisioned IRA aiding a German invasion of Northern Ireland, but both failed due to bungling and infighting.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: World War II in HD Colour: Overlord
programme.desc: After a careful campaign of disinformation that throws the German defenders off-guard, the Western Allies finally land on Normandy.France is liberated.

programme.title: Gunsmoke
programme.desc: A rancher who has been threatened refuses Matt's help.

programme.title: Gunsmoke
programme.desc: A woman who has been feeling neglected by her husband manipulates him into fighting a neighbor.

programme.title: Gunsmoke
